purpose: Character-style exploration only; no final action sheets

prompts.name: Ascua
prompts.brief: Warm, charismatic forest adventurer. HERO: copper-orange pointed cap with a distinctive swept-back hooked tip and one dark repair seam, huge pointed ears, sun-warm olive skin with freckles, short tousled dark hair, thick expressive eyebrows and a cheeky asymmetric grin. Short petrol-blue wool jacket over ochre shirt, burnt-orange neckerchief, dark short trousers and scuffed bark-brown boots. Compact agile build, head and cap together about half his height, confident hands-on-hips-ready stance. Simple acorn satchel at his side. Friendly streetwise charm, unmistakable at thumbnail size. NEIGHBORS share warm expressive faces and crisp illustration: one dark-skinned woman in plum point-cap and moss clothes, one older ruddy tan man in a bent slate-blue point-cap and oat vest; avoid hero orange cap.
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original Magikitos woodland duende character design exploration; NOT a final animation atlas.
Create one landscape 1536x1024 character lineup on a genuinely transparent RGBA background. Three separate equal-width columns, exactly three full-body characters. LEFT is the main protagonist, MIDDLE and RIGHT are two different village neighbors in the SAME art/design family. All feet on the same baseline around y=890, each figure approximately 720px tall including their POINTED HAT. Keep each complete silhouette comfortably within its own third, no touching, no cropping, generous empty margins. No text, captions, borders, ground, scene or cast shadow.
Camera: consistent slightly elevated top-down RPG three-quarter FRONT view for all three, able to see a little top of their hats and shoes. Solid grounded feet, arms clearly separated from torso. Not a front portrait and not an isometric tile. Polished high-definition PIXEL ART with intentionally shaped clean color clusters, controlled edges, readable anatomy and fabric, no grain or stippled noise, no fuzzy painting, no vector clip art. Design must survive reduction to about 40 world-pixels tall with a 2x-density texture.
All are small adult folkloric forest duendes from northern Spanish woods, NOT human children. All have unmistakable long pointed ears and pointed caps. Friendly irreverent energy, bold mischievous faces and clear distinct silhouettes. Heroes feel cool, resourceful and cheeky, not generic cute toddlers. Original designs, not Link, not Zelda costumes, not Disney dwarfs. No swords or shields, weapons, text or logos. Nature/scavenged-fabric clothes; no armor. A small simple satchel is fine, keep hands empty so future action animation is possible.
The hero's signature cap silhouette and color combination must NOT be copied exactly onto the neighbors. Neighbors vary skin tone, age and cap shape while all still wear pointed hats. One female-presenting and one older male-presenting neighbor; protagonist young adult male-presenting. Neighbors should not overshadow the hero.

prompts.name: Zarzal
prompts.brief: Wild woodland punk, angular and mischievous, still charming and trustworthy. HERO: soft olive-green skin, very large angular ears, narrow expressive amber eyes with bold brows, sly wide grin, unruly nearly-black tuft. Dramatic mulberry-purple POINTED cap with a single sharp crooked bend, low broad base and tiny stitched patch; no crown, no horns. Short midnight-blue sleeveless vest with ochre cords over leaf-green rolled sleeves, russet sash, cropped trousers and leaf-wrapped brown ankle boots. Wiry angular compact duende, strong silhouette, about 2.8 heads tall including cap. Hands resting confidently at waist, empty. NEIGHBORS in same angular folkloric style: warm-brown woman with mustard leaf-seamed pointed cap and russet jacket; older pale-sage man with dark teal pointed cap and cream bushy eyebrows. None share hero purple hat.

prompts.name: Trasto
prompts.brief: Inventive woodland scavenger with stout but agile proportions and the most memorable comic face. HERO: rich warm dark-brown skin, broad friendly nose, expressive thick brows, confident slightly lopsided grin, short black curls and very long pointed ears. Mustard-yellow POINTED cap with a distinctive long sideways fold ending in an upturned point, one oversized rusty-copper repair patch. Teal cropped vest, brick-red cloth sash, cream rolled sleeves, brown shorts and broad battered ankle boots. Reused oak-button belt clasp, tiny plain satchel, no tools held. Body sturdy and compact, not an infant, dynamic confident stance. Clean broad graphic color shapes with delicate pixel shading, original clever rogue. NEIGHBORS: rosy olive woman with a deep wine-red pointed cap and ochre clothes; older cool-brown man with a sage pointed cap, round nose and cream short beard. Same playful scavenged-material family but hero hat remains unique.

prompts.name: Candil
prompts.brief: A mischievous nocturnal forest sprite, elegant but earthy rather than a wizard. HERO: muted blue-grey skin, huge outward-pointed ears, vivid amber eyes (not neon or glowing), sharp cheeky grin and expressive dark brows; a little dark aubergine hair. Deep turquoise POINTED cloth cap with a very recognizable forward-curving tip and warm coral underside. Short brick-red coat with asymmetric wood toggle, soft indigo cropped trousers and moss-brown pointed ankle boots. Slender nimble duende with a compact large expressive head, confident hands at belt, a simple side pouch. No robes, magic wand, sparkles, runes or glow; it must fit a sunny forest too. Restrained cool palette with strong coral/teal hero contrast and elegant pixel clusters. NEIGHBORS: warm-copper-skinned woman with a plum peaked cap and olive coat, older pale-grey man in ochre peaked cap and dark moss vest. Both unmistakably same pointed-ear forest species, quieter signature shapes.
